cc:Work.dc:title: WallMounted - WallRack
cc:Work.dc:description:
Wall mountable rack for spices or other items
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes WallRack --x 150 --y 60 --sh 80:120 --outside 1 --top_edge y --full_height_top 0 --wall_height 15 --back_height 2 --side_edges F --flat_bottom 1 --thickness 4 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes WallRack --x --y --sh --outside --top_edge --full_height_top --wall_height --back_height --side_edges --flat_bottom --thickness --reference --labels
